about_the_game:
Find Oann is a single-player horror shooter with an intense and mysterious story.

The player takes on the role of Thomas, an ordinary man who finds himself in trouble after bizarre creatures appear, trying to kill him.

Story

Thomas is a geologist who goes to perform a routine job on a farm when, mysteriously, monsters begin to appear, trying to kill him. What first seems like an unexpected nightmare soon reveals itself to be part of a plan when he discovers instructions about finding someone named Oann and saving him.

Gameplay

  • Explore and find items, notes, and weapons.

  • Manage stamina to dodge enemy attacks during combat.

  • Use an alarm clock to attract or reposition enemies—either to eliminate them or avoid getting caught.

  • Use med-kits to manage health and stay alive.

content_descriptors.notes: Cointain blood and gore violence against monsters.
